title: Location cannot be accessed / undelivered
keywords: cannot access location undelivered return next working day returned status condo restricted
body: Agent calls the customer and keeps the call log.
Update the job to Undelivered with photo proof and the call log.
Return the item the next working day and update the job to Returned with photo proof.
Items go back to the sender when: customer can't be contacted and location can't be accessed; a medical item and the customer hasn't advised how to receive it; or the address is in a restricted area.
TikTok non-perishables: one re-attempt within 2 working days, then return to seller (return fee to driver). POD and call logs uploaded before marking undelivered.
